1.1.disposition: Function equivalence: catgets independently consumes gencat output; Python reads msgfmt output. gettext catalogs and iconv bytes are authored independently. Complete libc equivalence remains open.

1.2.disposition: Finite argv/files/output only; implementation limit ceilings and exhaustion are open. Runtime bounds are recorded separately, never claimed as utility maxima.

1.3.disposition: Grammar notation informs fixture input; not a separately executable assertion.

1.4.disposition: Per-page rows map streams, files, options, errors, environment and effects. Operand ordering and byte conversion have witnesses. Unused stdin offsets, eight-bit environment names, interruption, temporary-file cleanup, error continuation and remaining syntax guidelines remain open.

1.5.disposition: Large-file offsets and files over 2 GiB remain unqualified; catalog tests use bounded disposable inputs.

1.6.disposition: All seven selected providers are invoked directly by absolute pathname, through public cshell PATH dispatch in string/file/stdin modes, and by explicit cshell exec. Missing providers fail setup.
